## location
*2 run(s) carry the archive's own value (submitter-deposited), not a manuscript claim.*

**24 run(s)** — rule `corredor21-PRJEB36444-location` — 10.1093/plcell/koab049  
*Supplemental Data Set 1 (tpc.00530.2020-s01.xlsx), header at row 4*

> Pst sample table, 158 rows spanning three studies via a 'Data reference' column: Hubbard 2015 (33, SRX accessions), Bueno-Sancho 2017 (97, ERS) and 'This study' (26, ERS4270273-ERS4270298, exactly PRJEB36444). Columns: Sample ID, Collection date, Country, Location, Wheat variety, Data reference, Accession number, then alignment statistics. Every 'This study' row carries a town: Louville-la-Chenard, Adisham, Dereham, Mersea, Otley, Newton, Whittlesford, Glenrothes, Hemmingen, Melton Mowbray, Headley Hall, Ickleton, Newark, Fowlmere, Allonnes, Layerdelahaye, West Wickham, Chelsworth, Bohl-Iggelheim. The sheet has one key error: ERS4270296 appears on both 15.0040 (Cambridge) and 15.0130 (Whattisham) while ERS4270297, which ENA does hold, appears on none. Rows are otherwise in strict ascending accession order, so the intended mapping is almost certainly 296 then 297, but that is an inference about a typo and the two towns are 50 km apart, so corredor21.py drops both rather than guessing. The Bueno-Sancho block's '14.0083 Bohl-Iggelheim' independently confirms the reading of PRJEB15280's 'Germany: Bohl Bauch 10'.
